goals: Increase perceptible contrast between page background and card/panel surfaces.
Improve visual separation and grouping between adjacent blocks.
Strengthen information hierarchy without making the interface aggressive.
Preserve the approved typography family and weight grammar; do not introduce mixed typefaces or monospace except intentionally technical internal-only data.
Use brand colors semantically: red for primary/action/attention, green for success/complete/forward, amber only for warning/pending, navy/blue/gray for neutral/info/supporting hierarchy.

visualSystem.humanGate: Paula must visually validate the updated grammar on Ops/Leads business card, inbox, insurer Products/Documents/Knowledge, Activity, Quality and Renewals before B4-003 can close.

whatsappArchitecture.intent: Centralize WhatsApp-related customer communication in Gravicentra and link each conversation/event to canonical client, lead/business and management records.
verifiedPlatformContext: WhatsApp Business Platform/Cloud API is intended for programmatic messaging and CRM/backend integrations.
WhatsApp Business App can participate in Communities it is already part of, but official Help Center states that creating a Community in the Business app is not currently supported.

Current official Business Platform materials reviewed do not establish a supported Communities API endpoint; therefore Communities must not be treated as an automatable canonical integration until official Meta support is demonstrated for the tenant/account.
phaseAArchitecture: Create a canonical WhatsApp conversation/thread binding keyed by phone/WABA conversation identity and linked to clienteId plus optional negocioId/gestionId/polizaId.
Inbound/outbound messages and approved-template sends should create human-readable timeline events on the linked record.
From Cliente/Lead/Ops, users should be able to open the linked WhatsApp conversation context instead of creating disconnected notes.
Do not scrape WhatsApp Web or use browser automation as a production integration.
If Groups API eligibility is later confirmed for the actual WABA, model a group as another conversation context; do not equate a Group with a Community.
Treat WhatsApp Communities as external/manual context unless and until an official API with account eligibility and permissions is demonstrated.
privacyAndScope: Respect role/data-scope visibility; linking a WhatsApp thread never widens access to a client/lead/management record.
Store only the business-required message metadata/content under approved retention and consent rules; do not expose phone/contact data beyond scope.
whatsappArchitecture.currentGateTreatment: Architecture frozen so it is not forgotten. Do not expand B4-003 into an unproven Communities implementation. Existing WhatsApp buttons/links must remain compatible with the future canonical conversation binding.
